dedupe_keys.name: external magnetic fields effect on harmonics measurements with rogowski coils

description: Mingotti Alessandro and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. An experimental setup tests three off-the-shelf Rogowski coils while currents become increasingly distorted and external magnetic fields are applied. Coverage is the combined influence of waveform distortion and magnetic environment on current-sensor accuracy. The source reports an effect on the 50 Hzcomponent but no influence on harmonic evaluation under the tested conditions. Other Rogowski datasets address temperature, proximity, burden or position; they are not assumed to use independent instruments or reproduce this exact experiment. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The test assesses power quality measurement accuracy under magnetic interference.
